newsitem.title: KENYA: Demand for good quality coffee pushes prices up.
newsitem.headline: Demand for good quality coffee pushes prices up.

text.p: Kenyan coffee prices moved up a further $20 on strong demand for good quality arabica coffees, auction officials said.
Grade ABs averaged $291 per 50-kg from $268 while grade AAs averaged $296 from $274. Grade Cs averaged $279 from $261.
"A general shortage of coffee in the overseas market has been pushing prices upwards this year," a trader said.
The Coffee Board of Kenya sold all 45,800 60-kg bags of coffee on offer compared to 45,723 bags sold last week.
